subject: SpiralTech: SIG + SOC2 evidence request and delivery timeline
messages:
From: Eliot Barnes <eliot.barnes@spiraltech.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sophia Li <sophia.li@spiraltech.com>, procurement@spiraltech.com
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Initial request: SIG + SOC2 evidence and mapping

Vanessa —

Thanks for the demo last week. Spiral is starting a formal procurement packet and we need a couple of things to move the security review forward: a completed SIG template (we've attached our master), high-level SOC 2 summary, and a control mapping that links your controls to Spiral's SIG rows.

Specifically, the security team has asked for:
- Control owner / evidence for encryption at-rest and in-transit (KMS details preferred)
- Access review cadence and a recent export of the last access review
- Data retention policy excerpt and deletion procedures for customer data

Target timeline: procurement needs deliverables by 2027-04-06 to make the April 15th board review. Can you confirm feasibility and ownership on your side?

I've attached the Spiral SIG template in XLSX for your mapping.

Thanks,
Eliot Barnes
Senior Procurement Manager
SpiralTech
(attachment: spiral_sig_template.xlsx)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eliot Barnes <eliot.barnes@spiraltech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial request: SIG + SOC2 evidence and mapping

Eliot —

Appreciate the clear ask and the deadline. Confirming we can meet the 2027-04-06 target with a staged delivery:
1) By 2027-04-01: SOC 2 summary + initial control mapping for high-risk sections (encryption, access control, incident response).
2) By 2027-04-05: full SIG template completed and supporting evidence bundle.

I've looped in Karthik to help with any contract/timing constraints and to coordinate a short working session with your security team.

Attachments I'll provide in the first delivery: redwood_soc2-summary.pdf and a starting control_mapping_spreadsheet.xlsx (we'll populate Spiral's XLSX into our mapping format). If there are specific evidence formats you require (PDF vs CSV), let us know.

Next steps: can we schedule a 45-minute working session on 2027-04-02 or 2027-04-03 to walk the high-risk mappings?

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood_soc2-summary.pdf; attachment: control_mapping_spreadsheet.xlsx)
From: Eliot Barnes <eliot.barnes@spiraltech.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sophia Li <sophia.li@spiraltech.com>, procurement@spiraltech.com
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 11:37:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Initial request: SIG + SOC2 evidence and mapping

Thanks, Vanessa — that timeline looks good. A few clarifications from our security team (Sophia copied):
- For KMS: we need the key rotation policy and a sample rotation log (last 90 days). A CSV export is fine.
- For access reviews: we need the most recent export and a short note describing the reviewer roster and cadence.
- For data deletion: do you offer customer-initiated full-account deletion? If so, sample API call and confirmation evidence would be ideal.

We can do 2027-04-02 at 10:00 AM ET for the working session. Please share a calendar invite.

Eliot

(attachment: spiral_sig_template.xlsx — reattached for reference)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eliot Barnes <eliot.barnes@spiraltech.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SpiralTech: SIG + SOC2 evidence request and delivery timeline

Eliot —

Quick note on contracting / timeline: we're aligned to hit the deliverables by 2027-04-05 as Vanessa outlined. If Spiral intends to proceed to a Dedicated proposal after the security review, flag that now so I can prepare the corresponding pricing slide and timeline — that can affect artifact timing only if we need a reseller/compliance addendum.

Vanessa / Jonas: please confirm which files we'll include in the first bundle to Spiral and whether anything requires redaction before sending.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eliot Barnes <eliot.barnes@spiraltech.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 09:43:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SpiralTech: SIG + SOC2 evidence request and delivery timeline

Eliot / team —

Thanks for the specifics. Below is what we will deliver in the first package (by 2027-04-01 EOD PT):
- redwood_soc2-summary.pdf (includes scope, auditor, and time period)
- control_mapping_spreadsheet.xlsx (rows mapped to Spiral SIG; notes column with evidence pointers)
- kms_rotation_log_2027q1.csv (sample entries, redacted principal ids)
- access_review_export-mar2027.csv (export of the monthly access review)
- short README.txt describing evidence locations and redaction policy

Answers to the direct questions:
- Key rotation: automated rotation via our KMS provider; rotation policy attached in the README and sample rotation events in kms_rotation_log_2027q1.csv. We redact principal identifiers but retain timestamps and key IDs.
- Access review: quarterly cadence, reviewer roster is maintained with HR; the export shows reviewer, role, and action taken.
- Customer-initiated deletion: yes — we support a full-account deletion API and a manual verification step for enterprise accounts. I'll attach the API call example and a sanitized deletion confirmation in the second bundle.

I've uploaded the evidence bundle to a shared Drive folder and will share the link in the meeting invite. If Spiral needs signed attestations or auditor contact details, we can provide them after a quick PO/contract step.

Jonas Weber
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
(attachments: kms_rotation_log_2027q1.csv; access_review_export-mar2027.csv)

On Wed, Mar 31, 2027 at 08:02 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Eliot —
>
> Quick note on contracting / timeline: we're aligned to hit the deliverables by 2027-04-05 as Vanessa outlined. If Spiral intends to proceed to a Dedicated proposal after the security review, flag that now so I can prepare the corresponding pricing slide and timeline — that can affect artifact timing only if we need a reseller/compliance addendum.
From: Eliot Barnes <eliot.barnes@spiraltech.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sophia Li <sophia.li@spiraltech.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 14:25:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SpiralTech: SIG + SOC2 evidence request and delivery timeline

Team —

This is exactly what we needed, thank you. Confirming: we have the Drive link and the two CSVs (kms rotation + access review). We'll review and come back with any follow-ups by 2027-04-05.

We will keep the 2027-04-02 10:00 AM ET working session to walk the mapped controls for encryption and access control — I accepted the calendar invite. After that call, procurement will kick off the formal vendor packet for board review.

One ask prior to the working session: could you add a short line in the README about your log retention timeframe for KMS events (how long you retain rotation logs)? That will help Spiral's security be confident before the meeting.

Thanks again — looking forward to the session.

Eliot

(links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-spiral-security-packet)
